summary: SK Telecom filed a Form 6-K to announce a conference call for its 2026 second-quarter earnings results, scheduled for August 8, 2026, at 4:00 PM Seoul time. The call will cover earnings results and a Q&A session, with access via the company's IR website. This is a routine earnings notification, not a special situation filing. No deal details, stakeholder changes, or strategic events are involved.
